mechanism.claim: When an already high-volatility BTC day suddenly concentrates an exceptional share of its realized variance into one hour, then that concentration normalizes within six hours, the burst direction reflects exhausted urgent inventory and should reverse.
mechanism.side: opposite the frozen signed one-hour return at concentration onset
mechanism.why_distinct: HVCVCOIR is a causal realized-variance allocation state transition. It uses neither candle wicks, fixed calendar anchors, implied-volatility feeds, range boundaries, order flow, OI, nor a terminal candidate/control modification.

clock.decision: each completed 5m bar; accepted release enters at the next exact 5m open
clock.returns: causal close-to-close log returns through the completed decision bar
clock.day_variance: sum squared returns over the prior 288 completed 5m returns
clock.hour_variance: sum squared returns over the prior 12 completed 5m returns
clock.calibration: 2023H1 source-only: high-volatility q60, concentration-onset q90, and release q60; no source incidence or post-entry prices
clock.onset: false-to-true concentration >= q90 while high-volatility >= q60 and signed one-hour return is nonzero; freeze its sign
clock.release: within six elapsed hours, concentration <= frozen q60
clock.open_interest_confirmation: at release decision D, exact positive BTCUSDT period=5m sum_open_interest observations at D-4h and D with strict positive log(OI[D]/OI[D-4h])
clock.episode_rules: one pending episode globally; expiry cancels; no replacement while pending
clock.reservation: global half-open after acceptance; exit first at equal open

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.open_interest: read-only Postgres open_interest_binance BTCUSDT period=5m exact endpoints after preregistration
source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no threshold, release, OI endpoint or expansion rule, side, hold, or gate repair
